Field/Scenario: Create PF account with valid UAN
Preconditions: User logged in, no existing PF account for this UAN
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Retirement > Provident Fund (EPF/VPF). 2. Click 'Add PF Account'. 3. Enter UAN and select family member tag. 4. Save.
Expected Result: PF account (UAN container) is created and listed; no direct value shown until employer records added

Field/Scenario: Add first employer record under a UAN
Preconditions: PF account with UAN 100234567890 exists, no employer records yet
Test Steps: 1. Open the UAN. 2. Click 'Add Employer Record'. 3. Enter employer name, PF balance, join/exit dates. 4. Save.
Expected Result: Employer record saved under the UAN; aggregated PF value for this UAN = 450000.00

Field/Scenario: Add second employer record under same UAN
Preconditions: UAN 100234567890 has one employer record (Infosys, 450000)
Test Steps: 1. Open the UAN. 2. Add a second employer record. 3. Save.
Expected Result: Second employer record saved; aggregation service sums both records = 1070500.50 for this UAN

Field/Scenario: Edit an existing employer record's balance
Preconditions: Employer record 'Infosys' with balance 450000 exists under UAN
Test Steps: 1. Open employer record. 2. Update balance field. 3. Save.
Expected Result: Record updated; aggregated UAN total recalculates to reflect new employer balance

Field/Scenario: Edit UAN's familyMemberTag
Preconditions: PF account exists with familyMemberTag=Self
Test Steps: 1. Open PF account. 2. Change familyMemberTag. 3. Save.
Test Data: familyMemberTag changed from Self to Spouse
Expected Result: familyMemberTag updated; net worth attribution for this UAN moves to Spouse in family breakdown

Field/Scenario: Remove an employer record
Preconditions: UAN has two employer records (Infosys 450000, TCS 620500.50)
Test Steps: 1. Open the UAN. 2. Delete the 'Infosys' employer record. 3. Confirm deletion.
Expected Result: Record removed; aggregated UAN total recalculates to 620500.50 (TCS only)

Field/Scenario: Delete entire PF account (UAN) with all employer records
Preconditions: UAN 100234567890 exists with 2 employer records
Test Steps: 1. Open PF module list. 2. Select the UAN entry. 3. Click Delete. 4. Confirm.
Expected Result: PF account and all child employer records removed; net worth aggregation excludes this UAN entirely

Field/Scenario: Reject UAN shorter than 12 digits
Preconditions: On Add PF Account form
Test Steps: 1. Enter a UAN with 11 digits. 2. Attempt to save.
Expected Result: Validation error: 'UAN must be exactly 12 digits'; record not saved

Field/Scenario: Reject UAN longer than 12 digits
Preconditions: On Add PF Account form
Test Steps: 1. Enter a UAN with 13 digits. 2. Attempt to save.
Expected Result: Validation error: 'UAN must be exactly 12 digits'; record not saved

Field/Scenario: Reject UAN containing alphabetic characters
Preconditions: On Add PF Account form
Test Steps: 1. Enter a UAN with letters mixed in. 2. Attempt to save.
Expected Result: Validation error: 'UAN must contain only digits'; record not saved

Field/Scenario: Reject missing UAN
Preconditions: On Add PF Account form
Test Steps: 1. Leave UAN field blank. 2. Attempt to save.
Expected Result: Validation error: 'UAN is required'; record not saved

Field/Scenario: Reject employer record with negative PF balance
Preconditions: UAN exists, adding new employer record
Test Steps: 1. Enter a negative balance. 2. Attempt to save.
Expected Result: Validation error: 'Balance cannot be negative'; record not saved

Field/Scenario: Reject employer record missing employer name
Preconditions: UAN exists, adding new employer record
Test Steps: 1. Leave employer name blank. 2. Attempt to save.
Expected Result: Validation error: 'Employer name is required'; record not saved

Field/Scenario: Reject employer exit date before join date
Preconditions: UAN exists, adding new employer record
Test Steps: 1. Enter dateOfExit earlier than dateOfJoining. 2. Attempt to save.
Expected Result: Validation error: 'Exit date cannot be before joining date'; record not saved

Field/Scenario: Employer PF balance of zero
Preconditions: UAN exists, adding new employer record
Test Steps: 1. Enter balance = 0. 2. Save.
Expected Result: Record saved with zero balance; contributes 0 to aggregated UAN total

Field/Scenario: Very large employer PF balance
Preconditions: UAN exists, adding new employer record
Test Steps: 1. Enter a very large balance value. 2. Save.
Expected Result: Record saved; aggregation handles large BigDecimal correctly without overflow/truncation

Field/Scenario: UAN with all identical digits (edge format)
Preconditions: On Add PF Account form
Test Steps: 1. Enter a 12-digit UAN of repeated digits. 2. Save.
Expected Result: Accepted as a syntactically valid 12-digit UAN (format check passes; no uniqueness issue assumed)

Field/Scenario: Duplicate UAN across two PF account entries for same user
Preconditions: User already has a PF account with UAN=100234567890
Test Steps: 1. Attempt to add a second PF account with the same UAN for the same user. 2. Save.
Expected Result: System rejects duplicate UAN for same user with message 'UAN already exists' OR merges into existing UAN's employer list (per business rule) — duplicate is NOT created as a separate module row

Field/Scenario: Aggregation of multiple employer PF balances into net worth
Preconditions: UAN has 3 employer records: 450000, 620500.50, 0 (zero-balance closed account)
Test Steps: 1. View net worth dashboard. 2. Check retirement bucket contribution from this UAN.
Expected Result: Net worth retirement bucket reflects sum of all employer records for the UAN = 1070500.50; allocation class = DEBT (PF is debt-like)

Field/Scenario: Same UAN shared across two family members (joint tracking edge case)
Preconditions: Two family member profiles exist under one user account
Test Steps: 1. Add PF account for 'Self' with UAN X. 2. Add PF account for 'Spouse' with same UAN X. 3. Save both.
Test Data: uan=100234567890 for both Self and Spouse
Expected Result: System flags this as unusual (UAN is individual-specific) — either blocks or warns that a UAN cannot belong to two different family members

Field/Scenario: SQL injection payload in employer name field
Preconditions: UAN exists, adding new employer record
Test Steps: 1. Enter SQL injection string in employer name. 2. Save.
Expected Result: Input is safely parameterized/escaped; no SQL execution occurs; value stored as literal text or rejected by validation

Field/Scenario: XSS payload in employer name field
Preconditions: UAN exists, adding new employer record
Test Steps: 1. Enter script tag payload in employer name. 2. Save. 3. View the record in UI.
Expected Result: Payload is stored as escaped text and rendered inert (not executed) when displayed in employer list or reports

Field/Scenario: XSS payload in familyMemberTag
Preconditions: On Add PF Account form
Test Steps: 1. Enter script payload as familyMemberTag. 2. Save. 3. View list.
Expected Result: Payload rendered as plain text, not executed; no script runs in browser

Field/Scenario: Re-submitting the same Add Employer Record form twice (double-click save)
Preconditions: UAN exists, add-employer form open
Test Steps: 1. Fill form. 2. Rapidly double-click Save button before page navigates.
Expected Result: Only one employer record is created for Wipro (no duplicate record from double submission)

Field/Scenario: Verify PF module list rendering
Preconditions: PF account with UAN and family tag exists (employer aggregation not directly a listed column per module def)
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Retirement > PF list view. 2. Inspect columns shown.
Expected Result: List displays exactly 'uan' and 'familyMemberTag' columns as configured; aggregated value shown separately via aggregation service, not as a raw listColumn

Field/Scenario: Deleting a UAN updates net worth aggregation
Preconditions: UAN with employer records contributing 1070500.50 to Retirement/DEBT bucket in net worth
Test Steps: 1. Note current net worth total. 2. Delete the entire UAN (with confirmation). 3. Refresh net worth dashboard.
Expected Result: Net worth total decreases by 1070500.50; Retirement bucket and DEBT allocation class both recalculate excluding the deleted UAN
